about_this_file: All words, photos and links on the site live here. Every text has a zh (中文) and en (English) version. Keep the quotes and commas — if the site shows a red box, it tells you which line to check.

tagline.zh: 嗨，我是 Selina，喜歡把東西從零做到上線。
tagline.en: Hi, I’m Selina — I love taking ideas from zero to live.

intro.zh: 從前端到後端都能做。寫程式之前，我會先問：誰在用？他們卡在哪？
intro.en: Front end to back end. Before I write code, I ask who’s using it — and where they get stuck.

statement.zh: 會什麼不是重點。有 AI，什麼都學得會——重點是想學的心，和把事情負責到底。
statement.en: It’s not about what I already know. With AI I can learn anything — what counts is wanting to learn, and owning what I ship.

bio.zh: 我是 Selina，靜宜大學資管畢業，現在在念碩士。做過三年程式助教、一份全端實習，也遠端幫史瓦帝尼的客戶做過網站。我喜歡把東西從零做到上線的那一刻。
bio.en: I’m Selina — Information Management grad from Providence University, now doing my master’s. Three years as a programming TA, a full-stack internship, and a website for a client in Eswatini, built remotely. My favourite moment is taking something from zero to live.

traits.zh: 衝刺時全力投入，平常重視平衡
traits.en: All-in on sprints, balanced the rest of the time

traits.zh: 工作 ≠ 辦公桌，有 Wi-Fi 就能交付
traits.en: Work ≠ a desk — give me Wi-Fi and I deliver

role.zh: 獨立完成：需求、設計、開發、上線

alt.zh: 操作錄影：在 Sompisi Transport 預約接送
alt.en: Screen recording: booking a ride on Sompisi Transport

problem.zh: 史瓦帝尼的家族接送服務，旅客在網路上找不到，也不敢信。
problem.en: A family driving service in Eswatini that travellers couldn’t find online — or trust.

did.zh: 手機優先的網站：寫出真正的司機是誰，預約表單直接變成 WhatsApp 訊息。
did.en: A mobile-first site that names the real driver and turns the booking form into a WhatsApp message.

result.zh: 網站已上線；老闆不用學新工具，運作成本是 0。
result.en: Live; the owner learns no new tool, and it costs $0 to run.

talk.zh: 為什麼把 WhatsApp 當成整個後端？
talk.en: Why WhatsApp is the whole back end

alt.zh: 操作錄影：在 TripTally 記一筆旅費
alt.en: Screen recording: logging a trip expense in TripTally

problem.zh: 出國分帳遇到好幾種幣別，最後總是一團亂。
problem.en: Splitting trip costs across currencies always ends in a mess.

did.zh: 10 秒記一筆：多幣別、每日預算、沒網路也能存。
did.en: Log an expense in 10 seconds: multi-currency, daily budgets, works offline.

result.zh: 我自己的旅行都用它記帳。
result.en: I use it on my own trips.

talk.zh: 為什麼記帳當下就鎖定匯率？
talk.en: Why the exchange rate is locked in at entry time

title.zh: 好市多退貨 AI 流程
title.en: AI returns flow for Costco TW

kind.zh: 研究所案例・4 人小組

role.zh: 流程分析、提示詞設計、LLM 測試
role.en: Process mapping, prompt design, LLM testing

alt.zh: 重新設計後的退貨流程，AI 步驟以紅色標示
alt.en: Redesigned return flow with the AI steps in red

problem.zh: 退貨申請常資料不齊，客服得對照六類以上的例外規則。
problem.en: Return requests arrive incomplete; staff check six-plus exception rules by hand.

did.zh: LLM 把來信整理成案件、標出缺漏和可能的規則、草擬回覆，最後由客服決定。
did.en: An LLM turns the email into a case, flags gaps and likely rules, drafts the reply — staff decide.

result.zh: 用 11 項標準實測 Claude、Gemini、ChatGPT 會在哪裡出錯。
result.en: Tested Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT against an 11-point checklist to see where each fails.

talk.zh: 為什麼最後決定權留給人？
talk.en: Why a human keeps the final call

text.zh: 正在找遠端全端或 AI 相關職缺。一天內回覆。
text.en: Looking for remote full-stack or AI roles. I reply within a day.
